title: Block pages and the Blocks index
summary: The /blocks index with a lazy, inert thumbnail per block, each block's page with its framed preview, desktop and narrow toggle, Anatomy drawn over the frame, install command, file tree, sources and Built from, and the bare /blocks/<id>/preview route the frames load, in Neutral.

supporting.reason: Mounts the real route tree in a browser: every block's card and page, the frame's scale and narrow toggle, Neutral on a preview's portals in both modes, and axe on /blocks and /blocks/sign-in-01 in both modes at both widths.

Opens every block page's Anatomy at the desktop and narrow preview widths in both modes: one outline and label per visible Built from entry where the frame's own geometry puts it, labels apart and inside the preview, the legend's links and not-shown marks, axe with the panel open, the Chart recipe on Revenue, repositioning on resize and toggle, the switch, and no overlay on the index.
